**`scl-001` Daily comms routine — Gmail, Slack & GHL**

Merged SOP steps:

**`scl-005` GHL logging & task-naming conventions**

Merged SOP steps:
- Leave an 'internal comment' on the GHL contact record for every single client interaction.
- Format every GHL note strictly as: Date - Reason for follow-up or communication - Team member name (e.g., "May 19, 2026 - Followed up regarding website revisions - John").
- Create a task inside GHL attached to the client's contact record for any new project build or support request.
- Name every GHL task strictly using the convention: Client Business Name | Task Description.

<details><summary>Guidance for the team (9 tasks)</summary>

**`scl-049` Draft the eBook lead-magnet content with ChatGPT**

Merged SOP steps:
- Review the client's onboard form to identify their key customer pain points.
- Open ChatGPT in a new tab and prompt it to create an eBook lead magnet outline for the client's business.
- Review the generated outline to ensure it covers the specific pain points; prompt for revisions until it meets standards.
- Prompt ChatGPT for the full eBook content draft that you can review and copy-paste.

**`scl-055` Add client testimonials to the eBook draft**

Merged SOP steps:
- Open a new tab, go to Google, and search the client's company name.
- Open their Google Reviews and locate the most relevant, recent 5-star reviews.
- Copy 3 to 5 testimonials into the final section of the Google Doc draft.

**`scl-060` Send the eBook draft for client review & approval**

Merged SOP steps:
- Upload or create the Google Doc in the client's assigned Google Drive folder.
- Send the Google Doc link to the client via LaunchBay for review and approval.
- Wait for client approval on the text before building the page.

**`scl-062` Import the approved doc into Gamma**

Merged SOP steps:
- In Google Docs: File > Download > Microsoft Word (.docx).
- Log into Gamma.app and open the "Client eBooks" folder.
- Create new AI > Import file > upload the Word document.
- Select "Webpage" as the output format, then Continue.
- Choose "Card-by-card" and confirm "Yes, split for me".

**`scl-072` Refine the Gamma cards & generate the page**

Merged SOP steps:
- Go through each generated card to check how the text is segmented; make manual adjustments as needed.
- Click Continue, select a visual theme suited to the client's brand, then Generate.

**`scl-077` Apply the client's branding in Gamma**

Merged SOP steps:
- Theme > Customize in the Gamma editor.
- Open the client's website; use the Color Picker for Chrome extension to grab their primary brand hex, and apply it in Gamma.
- Use the What The Font extension to identify their font and match it in Gamma's typography settings.

**`scl-082` Set up CTAs & images in Gamma**

Merged SOP steps:
- Select the CTA buttons, set the link display to "Button", and paste the client's contact URL.
- Use Edit Image > Ask AI to generate or replace images to suit the client's services.
- Review the whole page and make any final layout changes.

**`scl-087` Publish the eBook & copy the live URL**

Merged SOP steps:
- Click Publish.
- Click View site and copy the live URL.

**`scl-089` Create the Switchy short link for the eBook**

Merged SOP steps:
- Go to Switchy.io and create a New folder named after the client, then Confirm.
- Paste the Gamma URL into the link field.
- Customize the short link to the format [clientname]-ebook.

</details>

**`scl-095` Build the Meta ad campaign strategy & creatives**

Merged SOP steps:
- Fill out the Meta Ad Campaign Strategy Doc using the template.
- Outline the eBook Lead Magnet campaign (broad audience targeting).
- Outline the Consult Offer campaign (warm retargeting audience).
- Specify audience targeting details (e.g., ages 35-55+, lookalike audiences, engaged followers).

**`scl-123` Set up & fund the Ads Team milestone in Upwork**

Merged SOP steps:
- Log into Upwork using credentials in LastPass.
- Navigate to the Ads Team contracts.
- Activate the "Facebook" setup milestone.
- Set the hours to 4 hours (at $12/hr = $72).
- Attach the approved Meta strategy document to the milestone.
- Fund the milestone so the Ads team can load the campaign.

</details>

**`scl-107` Assign client's FB Page, Ad Account & Instagram to allconvos.ai**

Merged SOP steps:
- Once Partner access is granted, log into the allconvos.ai Meta Business Portfolio.
- Under "Users", click on "System Users".
- Look for mktg@webindiainc.com or jayking6505@gmail.com.
- Click "Assign assets".
- Select "Facebook Pages" from the asset type list.
- Use the "Search" field to look for the client's Facebook Page.
- Click the checkbox next to the client's Facebook Page.
- Under "Partial access", toggle ON the "Content, Messages, Community activity, Ads, Insights" switch.
- Click "Ad accounts" from the asset type list.
- Use the "Search" field to look for the client's Ad Account.
- Click the checkbox next to the client's Ad Account.
- Under "Full control", toggle ON the "Manage ad accounts" switch.
- Click "Instagram accounts" from the asset type list.
- Use the "Search" field and select the client's Instagram account.
- Assign all permissions for Instagram.
- Click "Assign assets" and then "Done".

</details>

**`scl-129` Record the ad campaign walkthrough Loom**

Merged SOP steps:
- Record a Loom video walking the client through their new live ad campaigns.

**`scl-192` Generate bot objectives & knowledgebase via CloseBot GPT**

Merged SOP steps:
- Use the CloseBot Objective Builder GPT link (https://chatgpt.com/g/g-67ae76f80150819187fbb5fa67ddcec4-closebot-objective-builder) in a new chat.
- Change the yellow highlighted sections in the prompt template to reflect the client details (Bot Name, Client Website, Industry Insight, Pain Points, Objections, ICP).
- Run Task 1 (Generate Bot Details & Objectives Prompt) and Task 2 (Generate Knowledgebase Prompt) together in ChatGPT.
- Review the output for the 7 standard CloseBot Objectives: Pain Point, Motivation, Service Type, Email, Phone, Timezone, and Book Call.
- Ensure Max Attempts is set to 2 and Sensitivity is set to 50 for all objectives.

**`scl-197` Clone & configure the CloseBot bot**

Merged SOP steps:
- Log into CloseBot (app.closebot.com) using the stored team credentials.
- Clone the V2 bot (e.g., 'Susan' Agent and 'CONVERT' workflow or 'LenderlyAIv2' bot).
- Rename the bot to match the client details.
- Set Persona Name, 'How to Respond' section, and Tone according to the GPT prompt results.
- Select Provider as RTD OpenAi.
- Connect to RTDigital Agency and the appropriate client GHL subaccount.
- Turn ON "Bot Shutoff Manual Message".
- Turn ON "Graceful Goodbye".
- Turn OFF "Followup Availability" by default.

**`scl-206` Load knowledgebase & connect calendar booking**

Merged SOP steps:
- Paste the GPT-generated Knowledgebase into the "Knowledge" section (Knowledge library > Create text file).
- Click "website scrape", enter the client's website URL, and select website.
- Edit sources for both Knowledge entries and link them to the appropriate client subaccount.
- Ensure conversational booking logic routes to the GHL AI Calendar using the GET method.
- Log into GHL -> Account -> Calendar -> Calendar Settings, and copy the AI Calendar ID to paste into CloseBot.

</details>
